chapter: Leading his own band in New York
title: The best band: Galbraith and the overseas group
summary: The overseas band was among his best, and Frank Galbraith was a trumpeter modelled on Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Including the one overseas, you mean.
Well, that was the greatest band that I ever had.

on piano.
